column1: # Mahadevan 1998 and 2014: Dravidian values for the two endings and one four-sign phrase, on ICIT glyph ids.
# language: dra. 'The Arrow Sign in the Indus Script' (harappa.com/arrow, 1998): arrow = *ampu, non-masculine
# singular suffix *-(a)mp(u); jar = masculine singular suffix *-(a)nru. 'Dravidian Proof of the Indus Script via
# the Rig Veda' (Bulletin of the IRC 4, 2014): WOLF HOOK CROSSROADS JAR = mar-kol-pat-(a)nr- 'merchant of the city',
# his Fig. 2 = CISI II M-857, ICIT 255 435 690 740.

column3: jar; masculine singular suffix -(a)nru, 'he of the'
